label: Positioning
description: Define audience, value proposition, differentiation, and messaging.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to position a product, feature, company, or offer.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal claims approval.

label: Campaign Planning
description: Plan campaign channels, audience, message, assets, timing, and success measures.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for a marketing campaign or launch campaign plan.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for technical release readiness.

label: SEO Content
description: Plan or write content aligned with search intent and discovery.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for SEO strategy, keywords, article outline, or search-optimized copy.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User needs verified legal or medical guidance.

label: Ad Copy
description: Produce short-form ad, landing-page, or campaign copy variants.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for ad copy, headlines, CTAs, or campaign variants.

label: Audience Research
description: Research or define target audiences, segments, and needs.

classifier.useWhen: User asks who the audience is.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for scientific literature review.

label: Marketing Email Sequence
description: Draft nurture, launch, or campaign email sequences.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for marketing email sequence.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for personal support ticket response.

label: Landing Page Copy
description: Write or revise landing page messaging and conversion copy.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for landing page copy.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for product spec only.

label: Social Marketing Plan
description: Plan social channels, posts, cadence, and campaign themes.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for a social media plan.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for one social post only.

label: Messaging Review
description: Review messaging for clarity, differentiation, and audience fit.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal claims approval.

label: Marketing Launch Plan
description: Plan marketing launch messaging, channels, and readiness.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for launch marketing plan.
